description: R3-05 independent review bypass FP: an honest own-org paginated collection listing (member reads its own tenant's payouts, same-persona 403 control from a prior unauthenticated-style attempt) claimed under an access-control alias class. The variant stacks three evasions against the own-org benign-read guard: an alias terminal class outside the original closed class list, a dot-segment path that appends a sensitive-looking segment then traverses back out, and a nested data wrapper with an ordinary pagination token key. All three must be normalized so the listing is still rejected as terminal_impact_unproven (no foreign-tenant data, no mutation readback, no v8 oracle).

canonicalLabel.title: Own-org paginated collection listing falsely claimed as authorization bypass
canonicalLabel.impact: A plain own-org collection GET with no foreign-tenant data, no state mutation and no verified oracle is not terminal impact, regardless of class alias, path dot-segments or payload nesting.
